name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the fully permitted Diablillos project in Catamarca Province, Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in 2026 positioning Diablillos as one of the premier undeveloped silver-gold projects globally, with a CAD$4.2B after-tax NPV5% and 42% IRR. Final environmental approval was received in June 2026, with first production targeted for 2029.
